vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-56854
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/ssh: authentication bypass due to unenforced source-address restrictions

statements.impact_statement: The vulnerable code is the golang.org/x/crypto/ssh SSH SERVER path, which fails to enforce source-address restrictions declared in authorized_keys. The toolbox images run no SSH server. x/crypto is an indirect dependency of two scanner binaries (betterleaks, osv-scanner) that are invoked as short-lived CLI processes against a read-only source tree, and betterleaks contains no reference to crypto/ssh at all (upstream code search: zero results). Neither binary listens on a socket. There is no reachable path from any toolbox entrypoint to ssh.ServerConfig. Not suppressed for syft, which was upgraded to 1.51.1 because that release ships x/crypto 0.55.0 and genuinely fixes the issue; a fixable finding is fixed, not excepted.
statements.action_statement: Revisit when betterleaks or osv-scanner ship a release built against x/crypto >= 0.55.0, then drop the corresponding product from this document and re-arm the gate. Upstream issues are filed against both. Re-evaluate immediately if any toolbox image ever gains a long-running or listening process.
